app-templates.message:
feat: a 404 page leads unknown addresses to the app's start page, in place of redirects

## Intent

Redirects for moved pages are not needed yet: an app may drop a page and its address on purpose. A learner who follows an old or wrong address should still not end on a dead page. Every unknown address of an app should lead back to the app's start page.

## Key changes

- The redirects in app.yaml are gone again: no schema entry, no validation, no redirect pages, no handling in the dev server.
- The explainer and the quiz write a 404.html at the root of the bundle. GitHub Pages serves it for every missing path.
- The page says in short German that the page does not exist (any more), links to the start page and is not indexed.
- A small script finds the app's root: the nearest folder upwards that has its own 404.html. So the page also works under /<repo>/ and in a preview below pr-preview/pr-<n>/. It then moves on to that start page.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Changes app-templates#24 (i099) before it is merged.
